query.text: 生活助手，我听不见声音，请帮我留意门口有没有人敲门，有情况请提醒我。
query.text_en: Life assistant, I can't hear any sound. Please help me keep an eye on whether someone is knocking at the door, and remind me if anything happens.

annotation.text_en: Someone is knocking on the door.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
